## How to Run

```bash
# one-time asset preparation
uv run mlperf fetch --workload information-retrieval --profile max

# benchmark run (writes JSON/HTML/CSV reports + .provd provenance)
uv run mlperf run --workload information-retrieval --profile max --open-report

# quick smoke pass
uv run mlperf run --workload information-retrieval --profile min

# research envelope
uv run mlperf run --workload information-retrieval --profile pro
```

See the [running guide](../../guide/running.qmd) for profile semantics, report handling, and power measurement flags.

**Reviewer notes:**

- The target is the exact three-dataset mean nDCG@10 published in the Sentence Transformers CrossEncoderNanoBEIREvaluator documentation for this model and configuration.
- The upstream example also publishes mean MAP 0.5531 and mean MRR@10 0.6401 as secondary metrics.
- Promotion requires exact local reproduction and a committed five-run timing sweep.

## Systems Experiment Execution Contract

**Within-run measurement protocol:**

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Primary metric** | inference_and_evaluation_seconds |
| **Scenario** | offline |
| **Timing scope** | median per-evaluation time across three unchanged complete cross-encoder scoring and official reranking evaluations for 50 queries and 100 candidate documents in each of three NanoBEIR datasets |
| **Included phases** | tokenization of query-document pairs, batched PyTorch cross-encoder execution, score sorting and MAP, MRR@10, and nDCG@10 computation |
| **Excluded phases** | dataset and model fetching, Parquet loading and sample construction, model construction, one untimed warmup for each scoring batch shape, and one untimed complete three-dataset evaluation, report and provenance serialization |
| **Device synchronization** | synchronize immediately before and after each measured complete inference-and-evaluation repetition |
| **Outer reference runs** | 5 |
| **Repeatability metric** | inference_and_evaluation_seconds |
| **Repeatability limit** | 0.05 |
